scenes.name: Through the transport yard
scenes.purpose: Establish the new destination and private security; Harper draws hesitant Taffy through cover.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous departure from the relay after the news reaction.

scenes.name: A sympathetic bargain
scenes.purpose: The scrapper chooses to help; reveal the unwanted ship as the way out.

transitionInProposal.reason: Omit travel through the yard and arrive at the scrapper’s corner.

scenes.name: A fine find
scenes.purpose: Delight becomes teamwork, then a visible failure and loss of a needed part.

transitionInProposal.reason: Follow the scrapper’s reveal directly into boarding.

scenes.name: Make do
scenes.purpose: Use the long instrumental for an errand, physical problem-solving and a compromised workaround.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continue directly from losing the cartridge to trying to retrieve it.

scenes.name: The deadline arrives
scenes.purpose: News converts a repair project into an immediate escape; the scrapper’s help is cut off.

transitionInProposal.reason: Power-up becomes the shuddering cockpit test and news interruption.

scenes.name: Borrow their countdown
scenes.purpose: Harper uses the clearance system’s own start command to interrupt port controls long enough to launch.

transitionInProposal.reason: Omit the short move from cockpit planning to the first terminal.

scenes.name: Almost away
scenes.purpose: Launch under pressure, reach the opening geography, then lose the climb.

transitionInProposal.reason: The clearance trigger causes the departure window; launch must feel immediate.

scenes.name: A different way out

transitionInProposal.reason: Descent continues into the hard landing; no suggestion of elapsed time.

shots.title: A different kind of checkpoint
shots.action: Leaving the relay, Harper spots a route between ground haulers and parked air vehicles. A visible-faced yard guard checks workers at a barrier. Taffy stalls behind cover as Harper slips through and looks back.
shots.camera: Moving medium-wide; relay exit behind, transport yard ahead.
shots.reviewOverlay: Leaving the relay, Harper slips into the transport yard. Taffy hesitates behind cover as a guard checks arrivals.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous departure from the relay after the news reaction.

shots.title: Are you coming?
shots.action: Harper gives a small urgent beckon. Taffy waits for a guard to turn toward an arriving hauler, then scurries across the exposed gap to her. They disappear toward the neglected back lot.
shots.camera: Reverse across the gap; guard foreground, Harper beyond. No second chase.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper beckons. Taffy waits for the guard to turn, then darts across to join her.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Together, then
shots.action: Harper offers the same fake jewel she used to distract the water boss. The scrapper studies it with a sudden flicker of recognition: he knows it is not a genuine jewel, but recognizes its importance as a missing piece for his collection. Taffy stays close. Begin the exchange here and carry the recognition into the next shot.
shots.camera: Close three-person composition; introduced through action.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper offers her fake jewel. The scrapper recognizes something she has overlooked.

transitionInProposal.reason: Omit travel through the yard and arrive at the scrapper’s corner.

shots.title: The ship nobody wants
shots.action: The scrapper accepts the jewel with careful delight, briefly comparing it with a related piece in his collection (visual staging proposal). Harper reads his acceptance as a successful bargain. He clocks the patrol, turns a hanging salvage panel to hide them and reveals the battered ship. He is not fooled by the jewel; its value to him is real.
shots.camera: Widen or move around the panel to reveal the concealed craft. Covering for them is visible, not explained.
shots.reviewOverlay: The fake jewel belongs in his collection. He accepts it, shields them from the patrol, and reveals the ship.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: A place to be
shots.action: Harper steps into the old craft; Taffy squeezes in behind. A dusty control briefly lights when he touches it. Their shared grin lands on So lucky.
shots.camera: From cabin toward entry, then a small reframing to their discovery.
shots.reviewOverlay: They climb aboard. A dusty control lights up; their luck seems to be turning.

transitionInProposal.reason: Follow the scrapper’s reveal directly into boarding.

shots.title: Lucky up to now
shots.action: Taffy finds an intact-looking regulator cartridge in an open service bay and presents it with pride; Harper clears space for him.
shots.camera: Medium detail with both faces readable; cartridge design provisional.
shots.reviewOverlay: Taffy proudly finds an intact-looking regulator cartridge. Harper clears space to work.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: A fine like you
shots.action: They work as partners: Taffy steadies the heavy assembly while Harper seats a connector. She gives him an appreciative look, then pats the ship as if the compliment includes it.
shots.camera: Two-shot with hands, faces and worn hull in one composition; action advances through the whole line.
shots.reviewOverlay: Taffy steadies the assembly while Harper connects it. Her appreciative look includes both him and the battered ship.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: True?
shots.action: The supposedly secure connector pops loose and the little test lamp dies. Their smiles flatten for a beat.
shots.camera: Brief insert; this is a mechanical warning, not the critical loss yet.
shots.reviewOverlay: The connector pops loose. The test lamp dies. Their smiles vanish.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: A little higher
shots.action: Harper guides Taffy lifting the cartridge into alignment. He clears a snagging cable and nudges it upward on Up.
shots.camera: Close medium on coordinated hands; retain natural anatomy, supported weight.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper guides the cartridge higher while Taffy clears a snagging cable.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: On the upbeat
shots.action: A sticky locking collar requires three coordinated taps. They develop a rhythm, becoming a little overconfident; on the last tap the cartridge starts to slip.
shots.camera: One continuous mechanical action spanning the short beat lyrics; do not cut on every word.
shots.reviewOverlay: Three rhythmic taps on a sticky collar. On the last tap, the cartridge slips.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Lost it
shots.action: Harper lunges and misses. The cartridge drops into an exposed lower door-closing linkage beside the repair area. The mechanism catches the cartridge; its imminent crush is clear. Use an opening large enough for the established cartridge, not a narrow floor grille.
shots.camera: Follow the falling part, then reaction; make what was lost unmistakable.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper misses. The cartridge drops into an exposed closing mechanism and jams between its moving parts.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: No retrieving that
shots.action: The closing linkage completes its stroke, crushing the cartridge casing and connector beyond use. They stare at the ruined part. The scrapper recognizes the problem and points them toward a donor wreck. Exact linkage placement is a staging proposal to establish before shot generation.
shots.camera: Close view of the crush and ruined connector, then the scrapper’s direction.
shots.reviewOverlay: The mechanism crushes the cartridge. The scrapper points them toward a donor wreck.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continue directly from losing the cartridge to trying to retrieve it.

shots.title: Donor run
shots.action: Harper and Taffy cross to a stripped ground vehicle. A guard passes; the scrapper rolls a salvage cart across the sightline while they crouch behind it.
shots.camera: Lateral tracking shot; distinct silhouettes and yard geography.
shots.reviewOverlay: They sneak to the donor wreck. The scrapper rolls a cart across a passing guard’s sightline.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Wrong part, useful part
shots.action: Taffy pries a substitute module from the donor while Harper braces a tool. It is visibly a different size; they take it anyway.
shots.camera: Medium hands-and-faces action; avoid another abstract repair montage.
shots.reviewOverlay: Taffy extracts a substitute while Harper braces the tool. The part is visibly the wrong size.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: An improvised fit
shots.action: Back inside, Harper bridges the mismatch with an adapter while Taffy holds pressure on a vibrating coupling. Their first test sputters, then steadies.
shots.camera: New angle deeper inside ship, visible transformation from loose parts to working assembly.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper improvises an adapter. Taffy holds the vibrating coupling until the test steadies.

transitionInProposal.reason: Compress return from donor wreck and some installation time.

shots.title: It lives, barely
shots.action: Cockpit displays wake. A patched drive trembles under load; they exchange relieved but uncertain looks. Outside, the scrapper notices a clearance convoy entering the yard.
shots.camera: Start on living cockpit, end with view through its window to the changing situation.
shots.reviewOverlay: The cockpit wakes, barely. Outside, the scrapper notices a clearance convoy entering the yard.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Hanging on
shots.action: The powered-up craft shudders on its supports. Harper grips an overhead rail while Taffy struggles to keep the test stable; then a local yard bulletin overtakes a cockpit display.
shots.camera: Interior medium-wide; power-up occurs on the ground.
shots.reviewOverlay: The ship shudders on its supports. A local yard bulletin appears on the newly powered display.

transitionInProposal.reason: Power-up becomes the shuddering cockpit test and news interruption.

shots.title: I saw the news
shots.action: Taffy points to the monitor. A presenter and a live yard inset announce a redevelopment clearance, using a recognizable yard map, moving clearance machines and a progress/countdown graphic.
shots.camera: Screen insert; glyphs communicate information without requiring readable invented text.
shots.reviewOverlay: Taffy spots the bulletin: the yard is being cleared for redevelopment. Machinery is already moving in.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Their ally is taken
shots.action: The live inset shows two private guards detaining the scrapper beside the same concealment panel. One takes his access badge.
shots.camera: Push into the inset enough to recognize him; no graphic violence. He is being removed, not established as permanently imprisoned.
shots.reviewOverlay: The screen shows guards detaining the scrapper and taking his access badge. Their ally is gone.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Wish we had not
shots.action: Harper looks from the feed to the real convoy beyond their window. Taffy reaches toward unfinished work. She closes the tool tray: there is no time.
shots.camera: Reaction two-shot linking screen, window and unfinished mechanism.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper sees the convoy outside. She shuts the tool tray: they must leave before repairs are finished.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Things left undone
shots.action: They strip the plan down to essentials: Taffy straps down the jury-rigged module, Harper checks the blocked departure route. An unused comfort fitting or ridiculous salvaged seat cushion becomes their rueful Fun things to do beat.
shots.camera: Active preparation, not another repair cycle; small humor under pressure.
shots.reviewOverlay: They secure only the essentials. A discarded comfort fitting earns a rueful look: so much for fun improvements.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: One more job together
shots.action: Harper traces the port’s linked control stations on a schematic and points to the clearance power circuit. Taffy recognizes her plan; they head out, leaving the ship ready.
shots.camera: Over-shoulder schematic into decisive movement. Seed the two terminals and trigger link.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper spots a link between clearance machinery and departure controls. One more job before they can leave.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: A plan worth thinking
shots.action: At the first service terminal outside their hideaway, Harper spots a link between the clearance machinery and departure controls. Taffy gives her an incredulous look as she signals that it can work.
shots.camera: Medium two-shot with guards moving in distant background.
shots.reviewOverlay: At the first terminal, Harper finds a possible way to interrupt port controls. Taffy watches the patrol.

transitionInProposal.reason: Omit the short move from cockpit planning to the first terminal.

shots.title: Same numbers
shots.action: Harper repeats a glyph sequence; rejected. She alters one step, repeats it and notices a recurring timing pattern. Taffy watches the patrol through a gap.
shots.camera: Close on motivated trial/error, then eyes recognizing the pattern; avoid prolonged illegible typing.
shots.reviewOverlay: Rejected combinations repeat. Harper changes one step and recognizes a timing pattern.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Again, somewhere else
shots.action: They move behind a stationary hauler to the second terminal. Harper enters the pattern there while Taffy diverts a guard’s sightline by rolling a loose bin into place.
shots.camera: Sideways movement establishes this is a second location, not a reset of the first shot.
shots.reviewOverlay: They slip to a second terminal behind a hauler. Taffy screens Harper from a guard’s view.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Set the trap
shots.action: Harper bridges the second terminal’s pending clearance-start command into a port-control interrupt. A diagram changes from blocked to armed; the clearance circuit remains live. She catches Taffy about to pull its power plug.
shots.camera: Over-shoulder to two-shot; simple repeated icons convey the linkage.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper arms an interruption triggered by the clearance-start signal. Taffy reaches to disconnect its power.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Do not turn it off
shots.action: Harper sharply stops his hand, then points at the pulsing armed indicator. He understands: the circuit must stay powered for the trigger.
shots.camera: Close reaction and clear stop gesture; Taffy is helping, not foolish.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper stops his hand: leave the trigger powered. She signals him back toward the ship.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Back to the ship
shots.action: Harper waves him toward the ship and follows through the service cover while the patrol is facing the approaching clearance crew.
shots.camera: Fast purposeful movement; route already established, no new terminal.
shots.reviewOverlay: They hurry back through cover. The clearance crew is about to begin.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Their bad news, our opening
shots.action: A clearance operator starts the machinery. The pending signal runs into Harper’s prepared link: tower displays and ground departure barriers lose control. Cut or rack to the ship’s independently powered cockpit confirming a departure window.
shots.camera: Cause-and-effect insert then cockpit; port-control outage, not loss of ship power. Can be split after review if needed.
shots.reviewOverlay: The crew starts clearance. Harper’s trap interrupts tower controls and departure barriers. Their ship stays powered.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Hang on
shots.action: Harper commits to launch while Taffy braces and secures the cabin. The ship claws out from concealment, wobbles clear of the yard and gains height through the controls outage.
shots.camera: Exterior lifting movement into cockpit reaction, or one exterior with visible cockpit acting; exact staging to refine.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper commits. Taffy braces. The ship wobbles up from concealment and clears the yard.

transitionInProposal.reason: The clearance trigger causes the departure window; launch must feel immediate.

shots.title: A city below them
shots.action: During the outro, the craft climbs above the settlement and mine roads. Its wobble settles; the two dare to believe they will escape.
shots.camera: Wide climbing view that reconnects the established opening landmarks; no extra orbital geography.
shots.reviewOverlay: They climb above the settlement and mine roads. The wobble settles; escape starts to feel possible.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Almost free
shots.action: At the high regional/suborbital viewpoint of the opening, the settlement has become small below. Harper and Taffy share a brief, earned look of triumph.
shots.camera: Opening-shot visual callback, then a cockpit view if time allows; one clear emotional crest.
shots.reviewOverlay: The high view echoes the opening. For one brief moment, Harper and Taffy think they have made it.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: The compromise fails
shots.action: The substitute module shakes loose under sustained load. The same warning lamp seen during the earlier repair returns; thrust stutters and the nose drops.
shots.camera: Readable mechanical insert to body reaction; failure tied to the workaround, not random bad luck.
shots.reviewOverlay: The substitute module shakes loose. The old warning returns; thrust falters and the nose drops.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Aim for the mine
shots.action: Harper fights the controls while Taffy holds the failing coupling. They divert from the settlement toward the mine perimeter, losing altitude fast.
shots.camera: Steep descending wide or cockpit with mine growing ahead; maintain geography.
shots.reviewOverlay: Harper steers away from town toward the mine. Taffy tries to hold the failing coupling together.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: The surface gives way
shots.action: The ship lands hard beside the excavation, slides onto a thin crust over an old worked chamber and breaks through. Dust swallows it.
shots.camera: Wide readable path from ground impact to subsidence; avoid a second separate crash.
shots.reviewOverlay: A hard landing beside the excavation. The ship slides, the ground breaks, and dust swallows them.

transitionInProposal.reason: Descent continues into the hard landing; no suggestion of elapsed time.

shots.title: Still together
shots.action: A short dark/dust beat, then emergency cabin light. Harper and Taffy exchange a stunned look; both are alive. Through the tilted opening lies an immense cavern.
shots.camera: Intimate reaction widens to reveal the unexpected space.
shots.reviewOverlay: Emergency light reveals both alive. Beyond the tilted doorway lies an enormous cavern.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Only a few steps
shots.action: They step out together, small against enormous rock-cut structures. Taffy’s light catches markings or dormant mechanisms. A faint response travels away from their footsteps.
shots.camera: Slow exploratory wide; the response is triggered by presence, not explicitly magic.
shots.reviewOverlay: They take a few cautious steps. Their presence sends a faint response through dormant structures.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.

shots.title: Something noticed
shots.action: Deep in the cave, a line of dormant lights or a massive embedded mechanism activates. Harper and Taffy stop and look up; end before its purpose becomes clear.
shots.camera: Hold the looming reveal and their shared silhouette for the musical tail. Threat is implied; no new creature design committed.
shots.reviewOverlay: Something immense activates deeper in the cave. They look up together. The next adventure is beginning.

transitionInProposal.reason: Continuous action or a detail/reaction cut.
